## PR Checklist / PR 检查清单

Please verify the following before submitting your PR / 提交 PR 前请检查以下内容：

### For Documentation Changes / 文档变更

- [ ] Chinese source file added/updated under `docs_source/zh/` / 已在 `docs_source/zh/` 下添加或更新中文源文件
- [ ] English translation added/updated under `docs_source/en/` / 已在 `docs_source/en/` 下添加或更新英文翻译
- [ ] Sidebar config updated in `docs_source/zh/config.ts` / 已更新 `docs_source/zh/config.ts` 中的侧边栏配置
- [ ] Sidebar config updated in `docs_source/en/config.ts` / 已更新 `docs_source/en/config.ts` 中的侧边栏配置
- [ ] Markdown front matter includes a `title` field / Markdown 头部信息包含 `title` 字段
- [ ] Content is accurate and follows existing formatting conventions / 内容准确且遵循现有格式规范

### For All PRs / 所有 PR

- [ ] PR title clearly describes the change / PR 标题清晰描述了变更内容
- [ ] Changes have been previewed locally with `pnpm run dev` / 已通过 `pnpm run dev` 在本地预览变更

## Description / 描述

<!-- Describe what you added or changed and why / 描述你添加或修改了什么以及原因 -->

## Type of Change / 变更类型

- [ ] New documentation page / 新增文档页面
- [ ] Documentation update / 文档更新
- [ ] Bug fix (broken links, typos, etc.) / Bug 修复（链接失效、错别字等）
- [ ] Configuration change / 配置变更
- [ ] Other / 其他
